across_seed_summary.caution: Only seeds with all four completed arms enter this table. Means are per-seed model metrics, not an ensemble or pooled repeated predictions. One seed has no estimated seed standard deviation.

protocol.selection: earliest maximum unrounded mean of dev intent accuracy and exact slot micro-F1
protocol.confirmation_policy: Seed 42 screen; run all four arms at registered seeds 17 and 101 if any changed arm improves both required metrics over its fresh seed-42 baseline. Report all completed arms, including regressions.

confirmation.policy: Seed 42 screen; run all four arms at registered seeds 17 and 101 if any changed arm improves both required metrics over its fresh seed-42 baseline. Report all completed arms, including regressions.

confirmation_only_summary.caution: Only seeds with all four completed arms enter this table. Means are per-seed model metrics, not an ensemble or pooled repeated predictions. One seed has no estimated seed standard deviation.

novelty_definition: Seen means (slot type, casefolded literal value) occurs in original train; words also fitted on train. Official exact scoring is unchanged.
limitations: Development selected checkpoints and is also used to assess proposals; bootstrap intervals omit selection bias and multiplicity adjustment.
Per-seed paired bootstrap measures utterance sampling conditional on checkpoints; across-seed standard deviation describes a different uncertainty.
The previously evaluated official test set has not been used or rescored by this analysis.
Do not treat a higher mean score with a decline in one metric as improvement in both.
Checkpoint bytes and recorded total parameter counts are verified; this results analyzer does not instantiate/count model tensors.

plan.trigger: A completed changed seed42 arm improves both metrics over fresh seed42 baseline, as already registered in protocol.json
plan.execution: Separate Python controller/worker processes may run concurrently with remaining seed42 arms on the same GPU. Weights, RNG state, data loaders, directories, and checkpoints are process-isolated.
plan.timing_interpretation: Per-arm times are descriptive under shared hardware load; do not claim a strict regularizer speed comparison.

audit.scope: Fresh zero-regularizer seed42 run versus preserved historical revised Stage2; no model inference
audit.note: Checkpoint metadata/code provenance differs; learned tensor state and predictions are identical.

metric_definition.probabilities: Stable float64 softmax of original float32 intent logits; no temperature fitting
metric_definition.nll: Mean ordinary unsmoothed negative log probability of the gold intent, in nats
metric_definition.ece_15: 15 equally spaced confidence bins [lower,upper), final bin includes 1; population-weighted absolute accuracy-confidence difference
metric_definition.brier: Mean sum of squared probability errors across all intent classes
metric_definition.top_k_ties: Descending logit, then ascending train-fitted class index

limitations: Development both selected the checkpoints and assesses calibration; these are not held-out test claims.
Raw logits were not stored during training: their argmax and decoded slots are exactly checked against saved predictions; their NLL is checked against saved ordinary dev CE.
ECE depends on binning and sample size; improved calibration alone does not imply higher intent accuracy or slot F1.
Means and sample SD use the same complete matched seed set as the performance report.
Incorrect-confidence means exclude seeds with zero errors; n is recorded. This is not probability calibration fitting.
The reporter merges explicitly supplied saved evidence; it does not perform additional inference.
